The year-end Grand Prix, the Arima Kinen. 
Smart Falcon, who came to watch with her 
Trainer, was overwhelmed by the sheer 
passion of the crowd.

The victor of the race was Daiwa Scarlet. 
With her at center stage, the Winning Live 
reached an awe-inspiring crescendo of 
excitement.

Watching the live concert from the front 
row, Smart Falcon resolves to make her 
next race, the Tokyo Daishoten, just as 
thrilling and exciting.

Dirt racing is fun. She has done 
everything she could, from promotions to 
lives. Reassuring herself that everything 
will be fine—
